<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election integrity protests:</strong> The INDIA bloc has petitioned President Murmu regarding &quot;vote chori&quot; (vote theft) allegations and plans to approach the Supreme Court, while authorities have detained protesters and locked down Delhi amid growing youth-led demonstrations against the Election Commission and the Modi government.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTFBvdG81emp0cUxmMlZQX1dXdGVXQmlmNGtjY3EzM2ZHZGFNYS1SVnFDazZPQk1aMGdWbFBhRFZwcjVOeG1Ibm1ZeEpETW1VQTNZSjdB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxQS25NS1lVdE9BWXluTnVDMkpxeDhMdWVwOU11N0ZQRnYwZEhnOFg3Mm44aEFIRXZIc09HLVRlYWhnZmZaV0VhQWJPRnRXeU5FQlQta0szcjRuYTVUNG45VXhCU3FtcXdHVkdfT0oyeGRMTENTYm9Vb1RIa2pfWWMyeGpCVUctbXlEYnFOY2hVTUtTa0hqTlBZNDlXNFhjdzFLUXJvdmVnOTZMZjRxTDFqZzJwSWs?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>BJP electoral gains:</strong> The BJP has strengthened its parliamentary position by winning the Nagaon Lok Sabha seat in Assam and securing eight of ten Rajya Sabha seats in Uttar Pradesh, with Prime Minister Modi citing these results as evidence of public support for the NDA&#x27;s governance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxONTd2MWV3T0hOSVA5d3lXcjRPZWJhYlZMWk5tMkxJTm5PZ2NsaXNscEFnQ0lmMGlZb2Z4Zk5Fd3NWZUNUNFRfaW1tUjgxSU5EbmMwR1BscTJFNUIzT0x4ZVg2YXpvXzZBYXlzMk00TE94aXVGWlAzdnRLN0ZEc1FmVmdRTDdSRzFEZF9BR1J1dmRjLVZBNXhFa0tfSDJkVnJxc2NoRnAtZmxta00?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission reforms:</strong> The Election Commission has announced a national initiative to eliminate duplicate entries from voter lists to improve electoral accuracy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxQS25NS1lVdE9BWXluTnVDMkpxeDhMdWVwOU11N0ZQRnYwZEhnOFg3Mm44aEFIRXZIc09HLVRlYWhnZmZaV0VhQWJPRnRXeU5FQlQta0szcjRuYTVUNG45VXhCU3FtcXdHVkdfT0oyeGRMTENTYm9Vb1RIa2pfWWMyeGpCVUctbXlEYnFOY2hVTUtTa0hqTlBZNDlXNFhjdzFLUXJvdmVnOTZMZjRxTDFqZzJwSWs?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Policy and governance:</strong> The India Mobile Congress 2026 continues to advance national technology policy, even as political controversy persists over the Karnataka government&#x27;s decision to increase ministerial car budgets during a period of drought-related fiscal strain.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a></span></li>
</ul>
